profile.headline: Digital Technology Leader | Software Engineer | Cloud & Data Strategy | IoT | Agile Transformation | Industry 4.0 | Driving Scalable Software at GE Aerospace
profile.geoLocationName: Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
Strategic and technically hands-on software leader with 28+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across aerospace, healthcare, and logistics. Currently leading digital innovation as a Lead Software Engineer at GE Aerospace, where I architected a cloud-based IoT monitoring platform that replaced a costly vendor system with an in-house solution—achieving significant cost savings and improved operational visibility.

Skilled in building and leading high-performance software teams, modernizing legacy systems, and implementing CI/CD pipelines to drive faster, safer deployments. Adept at cloud-native development (Azure, GCP), full-stack engineering (.NET, JavaScript, SQL), embedded systems (ESP32), and enterprise data platforms (Snowflake, DataStage). Strong track record of aligning technology with business strategy and fostering Agile culture across teams.

I thrive at the intersection of engineering depth, product vision, and leadership.   I’m passionate about enabling teams to solve real-world problems through innovative, scalable tech solutions.

Key Strengths:

Leadership & Team Building | Technical Migration Strategy | Agile Transformation

Cloud Architecture (Azure, GCP) | CI/CD | DevOps

IoT & Embedded Systems | Real-time Data Streaming 

Data Integration | ETL | Snowflake | Looker Studio

Cost Optimization | Lean Initiatives | System Modernization

positions.title: Lead Manufacturing Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineering strategy and execution for internal software products across manufacturing and compliance.

Built a secure, cloud-based IoT monitoring platform using ESP32 and Google Cloud, replacing a $30K/year vendor with a scalable in-house solution.

Developed CI/CD pipelines, code standards, and cross-team documentation to support Agile delivery.

Collaborated with manufacturing, quality, and IT leadership to align technical solutions with operational goals.

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer/ETL Developer
positions.description:
Managed data ingestion and ETL teams responsible for enterprise data integration and analytics.

Delivered Snowflake-based pipelines with real-time ingestion and robust QA frameworks.

Mentored junior developers and led Agile transformation efforts across multiple teams.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Here, I was engaged in several projects, focusing on the Item Weight modification and Dimension Maintenance C# .NET web page to display new item attributes and action data extracted from the E1 ERP database. I also created RF lot verifications and warnings that forced the user to move the recalled product to the recall zone if the item and order data met the complex criteria.
positions.insights: Application Programming, Software Development and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: I was responsible for ensuring unit and regression quality control on all projects before deployment to the testing environment. Demonstrated productive assertiveness while serving as a Technical Lead for over ten different technologies utilizing strong project planning and coordination skills. I programmed, maintained, and upgraded advanced warehousing industry software and resolved system issues.
positions.insights: Application Programming, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed warehousing applications using DcLINK and JDE.  These applications included receiving, picking, packing and inventory control. Designed and developed interfaces for our Onbase document management system.  These interfaces enabled users to retrieve document images directly from our ERP system via function keys.  Interfaces were also created to enable users to scan paper documents in the mail room to be forwarded to the Onbase Client queues in our accounts payable department using Onbase work flows.  Designed, developed and maintained a UPS and FEDEX data import/export system that integrated our shipping systems with our ERP system.
positions.insights: Application Programming, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer  MCSE
positions.description: I endowed myself with solid stress tolerance and problem-solving when administering user accounts, MS Exchange email, user network directories, and various types of network printers and servers. In addition, I successfully installed servers, switches, and network management devices while providing technical support for Windows clients and servers.
positions.insights: User Acceptance Testing and Computer Science
